## How we win, and what must be in the 9 December offer

### The demurrer is the real threat

Atty. Ramos did not fight my direct. His cross went to my lack of personal knowledge of the events before I became involved. After we rest he can move to dismiss on the ground that our evidence shows "no right to relief" (Rule 33 §1). If it is denied he loses nothing. So every element must be proved in our own offer, at least twice, without me. My testimony proves only what I did and saw myself.

### The order of argument

Class (Exh. E ¶7; Exh. B p. 3), then void (Art. 1898; Art. 1874 for the rule that the authority must be in writing; Art. 1409 that a void contract cannot be ratified), then not an innocent purchaser (Arts. 526, 528; PD 1529 §§51, 52), then no partition (Art. 496; Art. 1878[15]), then consequences (Arts. 449, 452, 546, 1678, 549, 2208, 2232, 2234), then the counterclaim falls. Lead with the class. Revocation is the backup, and Article 1922 is never argued both ways.

### Consultation must be proved, and not by hearsay

Non-consultation is part of our claim, so it is ours to prove (Rule 131 §1). The buyer's burden on her own good faith (_Bucton_) is a backstop only. In our case-in-chief it rests on the notarial registers and Registry files (no owner appeared or signed); in the defense stage, on their own witnesses under cross. First-hand proof comes from my mother on rebuttal. The class limit does not depend on consultation, which is why it leads.

### Damages need a peso figure

Exemplary damages require a temperate or compensatory award first (Art. 2234). No witness in our case gives a monthly rental value yet. On cross, Princess and Erwin are asked how many rooms are rented and for how much (Answer ¶27); their answer supplies it.
